prompts.town:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: master environment artwork for an original 3D life simulation game, production visual reference
Primary request: A beautifully art-directed small contemporary Japanese neighborhood called Hourglass of Life, where ordinary residents work, share quiet moments, and form relationships. Make the setting and character treatment coherent for a buildable game.
Scene: a compact walkable neighborhood of THREE small households, a working radio-repair workshop, a neighborhood bakery-cafe, and a pocket square. One home has a carefully cut-away front wall and roof to show its dining room and a parent and child building a miniature town together; other homes retain their roofs. Workshop has its open door and a recognizable wooden workbench; cafe has a few outdoor seats. Footpaths connect them logically. A modest shared bench faces the square, everyday plants, bicycles and useful lived-in objects. Everything sits on one shallow, neatly finished diorama foundation.
Characters: eight stylized Japanese human residents spread naturally through their daily life, with adults about 3.75 heads tall, readable human necks and joints, simple warm expressive faces, small but useful hands; a child is distinctly smaller. A woman baker with short dark bob, sage blouse and burnt-terracotta apron; male designer in indigo overshirt; child in mustard overalls; older repair craftsman with swept silver hair and muted teal work apron; older woman with camera and ochre cardigan; young cafe worker with chestnut tied hair and dusty coral apron; a quiet dark-haired adult with navy casual clothes and headphones; a student with dark soft hair and moss-green jacket carrying a small radio.
Style: polished original game-art 3D miniature with rounded but structurally believable architecture, subtle hand-painted color variation, matte painted wood, unglazed ceramics, visible broad fabric folds, restrained small details. Crisp silhouettes and clean geometry suitable for low-to-medium-poly game assets. Human characters, not animal villagers. No photorealism and no large anime eyes. No outlines.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2, elevated three-quarter dollhouse view, generous margins, full diorama visible, strong composition built around the shared square and warm cafe window; readable circulation and human scale.
Lighting: gently warm late-afternoon sunshine, soft amber highlights and cool teal shadows, tender lively everyday mood; clean pale warm-grey studio surround.
Palette: warm limestone cream, natural honey oak, sage and deep desaturated teal, small burnt terracotta and mustard accents.
Constraints: no logos, no legible signage, no title, no typography, no interface, no watermark, no gigantic hourglass monument, no fantasy buildings. This is an environment concept artwork, not a screenshot of an implemented game.
prompts.cast:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: eight-resident full-body cast lineup, production character art for an original 3D life simulation game
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference for the town and everyday clothing, not an edit target. Create a NEW character lineup image, not another town scene.
Primary request: exactly EIGHT distinct Japanese human residents, in one evenly spaced lineup, all fully visible from head to shoe, neutral relaxed standing poses with hands separate from torsos. Pale warm-grey studio background, soft neutral even light, no scenery.
Crucial proportion: charming but recognizably HUMAN stylized game models, adults exactly approximately 3.75 head-heights tall from crown to soles. Deliberately more deformed/short-bodied than the environment reference people; big readable heads, visible necks, modest adult shoulders, compact torsos, clearly articulated elbows and knees, normal functional hands. Not realistic tall fashion figures. Not baby dolls. Do not make all adults identical in face, build, or height. Child is much shorter (about 65% of adult height), about 3 heads tall. Elderly adults clearly look 65-68 with silver hair, softer facial age lines and distinct posture without caricature.
Left-to-right EXACT order:
1 NAGISA, 36-year-old woman baker, short neat dark bob, calm focused face, sage-green rolled-sleeve blouse, burnt terracotta bib apron with wide simple crossed back straps, cream tapered trousers, warm brown flat shoes; medium build.
2 RYO, 37-year-old man designer, slightly wavy short black hair, gentle expressive brows, indigo open overshirt over an off-white T-shirt, beige chinos, off-white sneakers; slightly taller and lean.
3 RIN, seven-year-old child, short tousled dark hair, lively face, mustard-yellow short overalls over a cream short-sleeve T-shirt, ivory socks and brown sneakers. No gender-coded school uniform.
4 OSAMU, 68-year-old man craftsman, swept-back silver hair, soft square face, slim understated round spectacles, no beard, oatmeal rolled-sleeve work shirt, muted deep-teal canvas work apron, slate-grey trousers, plain brown work shoes, slightly stockier and shorter; no tools in hands.
5 FUMI, 65-year-old woman, silver bob tucked behind ears, lively smile and gently aged face, ochre mustard cardigan over cream blouse, long warm-grey skirt, brown walking shoes, small camera on simple neck strap.
6 MAHO, 26-year-old woman cafe worker, chestnut low ponytail, friendly face different from NAGISA, cream blouse, dusty coral waist-to-bib apron, warm charcoal trousers, simple dark-brown shoes.
7 RITSU, 31-year-old adult, short softly parted dark hair, quiet thoughtful face, midnight navy relaxed knit top and navy ankle trousers, off-white sneakers, over-ear grey headphones resting at neck; slender build. No medical uniform.
8 AOI, 20-year-old student, medium shaggy dark hair, curious reserved face, moss-green utility jacket over an ivory shirt, charcoal relaxed trousers, warm-brown shoes, simple mustard-olive backpack. No handheld radio obscuring hands.
Style: clean high-quality original stylized 3D game character render with matte skin, subtly textured cotton and knit, broad simple fabric folds, softly sculpted readable facial features, restrained eyes, warm earthy color palette consistent with the reference. Hair built from simple large locks, not individual strands. Neutral lighting shows local colors accurately.
Composition: wide landscape studio production board with clear empty gutters between all eight people, no overlaps, align feet to one baseline, no one cropped. Let the lineup occupy nearly all canvas width while keeping generous edge margins. No extra portraits or repeated people.
Constraints: exactly eight residents, one appearance each, no title, no names, no text, no logos, no watermark, no background environment, no weapons.
prompts.cast_refinement:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: refined production cast lineup for a stylized 3D life simulation game
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Edit this EXACT eight-person sheet. Preserve the eight identities, facial features, hairstyles, clothing colors, every clothing design, left-to-right order, feet on one baseline, background and neutral studio illumination.
Change ONLY body-to-head proportions: the adult figures currently look about 4.5 to 5 head-heights tall. Make the adult characters visibly more deformed, with a full body height of approximately FOUR of their OWN head heights, including hair. Enlarge heads about 20 percent relative to the body, shorten torsos and legs gently, retain visible necks, adult shoulders, clear elbows and knees, functional hands and mature faces. Do not just zoom the figures. Keep their bodies human and articulated, not bobblehead dolls. Maintain believable small differences in age and build. The seven-year-old child stays distinctly shorter at about 65 percent adult height and three head-heights total. Older adults still visibly 65-68.
Keep the clean full-body framing and independent silhouettes with generous margins; exactly eight people. Crisp stylized sculpted 3D surfaces, matte cotton and knit, simplified hair locks. No extra views, no text, no logos, no watermark.
prompts.architecture:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: architectural production concept board for an original stylized 3D life simulation game
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND DESIGN REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create a new clean studio architectural asset board.
Subject: exactly THREE buildable neighborhood buildings derived from the supplied town: bakery-cafe, radio-repair workshop, small two-storey Japanese family house. Present a rigorous 3-column by 2-row board. Each column shows the SAME building twice: its complete exterior above and its roof-removed front-wall-removed dollhouse interior below. All six objects are separate and sit on individual shallow square foundations; ample clear space between.
Column 1: compact cream-plaster bakery-cafe, low dark slate tiled gable roof, sage fabric awning, broad wooden glazed facade, side service door. Exterior has one round outside table and two teal chairs, nothing obstructing entrance. Interior shows a simple service counter and bread display toward the front, compact baking preparation work surface behind, two small indoor tables with seats, logical clear walking paths.
Column 2: one-storey timber radio-repair workshop, warm timber eaves, muted sage-painted sideboards, dark tiled gable roof, wide sliding glazed double doors. Interior shows a long back-wall parts cabinet, one personal repair bench, one separate two-person shared worktable, two clearly usable stools, a small vintage radio on the work surface, clear room to walk around. Friendly lived-in but restrained.
Column 3: modest two-storey family home, warm ivory plaster and natural oak trim, small upstairs balcony, dark tiled gable roof. Matching two-level cutaway shows a ground-floor entry and dining/living room with a table, three chairs, child craft corner, compact kitchen, and a clear stair; upstairs has two simple bedrooms. Do not cram many rooms. House proportions should be small-town Japanese residential, contemporary domestic life, not medieval fantasy.
Style: polished original 3D miniature game art, rounded clean low-to-medium-poly forms, clearly constructed doors/walls/roofs, hand-painted local color variation, matte wood and plaster. Match the reference palette of warm cream, honey oak, sage, muted teal, terracotta and charcoal slate. Simplify ornamental plants and microclutter so doors, seats, circulation and interaction points are readable for modeling.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 production board, elevated three-quarter orthographic-like camera consistent across all views, unobscured interiors, whole foundations visible and no cropping. Buildings are at compatible human scale; cutaways remain recognizable as their exterior pair. Pale warm-grey background, diffuse neutral studio light instead of golden dramatic shadows, small soft contact shadows.
Constraints: no people, no additional buildings, no text, no dimensions or labels, no logos, no watermark. These are modeling references, not technical CAD or an actual rendered game screenshot.

prompts.props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game-prop concept atlas for 3D modeling and prototype presentation
Input image 1 is the town style reference. Input image 2 is the building/interior design reference. Use their coherent materials and object language, but create a NEW isolated object sheet.
Primary request: exactly TWELVE separate everyday game assets in a strict FOUR-COLUMN THREE-ROW grid, one object per cell, fully visible with generous empty transparent gutters, consistent elevated three-quarter view. Every object is separated; no scene or connected floor. These are production prop designs for the same gentle contemporary Japanese 3D life simulation game.
Row 1 left to right: (1) two-seat public bench with honey-oak slats and muted dark-teal metal frame; (2) sturdy two-person rectangular oak workshop table, a lower shelf, clear empty working top, no attached tools; (3) small round honey-oak cafe table with simple dark metal central pedestal, no chairs; (4) a single muted-teal spindle-back cafe chair with a wooden seat.
Row 2 left to right: (5) small portable vintage radio, honey-brown wooden case, cream tuning panel with two simple knobs and dark woven speaker grille, curved carrying handle; (6) compact vintage camera with silver and charcoal body, small round lens and neat folded brown strap; (7) charcoal over-ear headphones with broad simple headband and two clear cushions; (8) child's unfinished architectural model of three tiny houses on a small light-wood craft board, a few colored paper roof shapes, no loose debris.
Row 3 left to right: (9) a cream ceramic bread plate holding three distinct small bread rolls; (10) a single sage-green ceramic mug; (11) small leafy potted plant in a terracotta pot; (12) the game's signature HOURGLASS, a small beautifully crafted table object with dark walnut top and base, three thin aged-brass supports, a real hourglass-shaped glass vessel with narrow neck, frosted upper chamber, lower clear chamber with fine layered sand in muted warm ochre, terracotta, sage and teal. The sand occupies only the lower vessel, no glowing magic, no wings or clock face.
Style: clean original stylized 3D game prop render, round softened edges, simple structurally legible shapes, matte hand-painted wood, brushed aged brass, ceramic and cotton, restrained broad texture; same warm cream/oak/sage/teal/terracotta palette as references. Neutral diffuse light; highlights are gentle. Each object has its own readable silhouette with no touching objects or edge cropping. Objects are individually framed for readability, not all at identical real-world scale.
Background: ACTUAL transparent alpha behind every object and between all objects. No painted checkerboard, no white rectangle, no floor tiles, no scenery, no oval backdrop, no caption areas. Avoid cast shadows outside object silhouettes, preserve transparent gaps. No text, no typography, no numbers, no brand marks or watermark.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 asset sheet, 4 columns x 3 rows exactly.
